children: Getty Images intends to rely on 30-day grace periods for upcoming interest payments while evaluating strategic financing and a potential capital solution with its majority equity holders.
Engaged Guggenheim Securities to advise on strategic financing alternatives and balance sheet management.
Majority equity holders have formed a group to advance discussions on a potential capital solution.
Company plans to elect available 30-day grace periods for interest due Sept. 1, 2026 on its senior notes to maximize flexibility.
Company says it has sufficient cash to make payments and the grace-period election would not trigger an event of default.
